extraction.pages_processed: 3-8 (contents); 15-19 (key findings); 53-55 (digital tools and the internet) read in full; 56-58 (migration and mobility) read to apply the Chapter 2 boundary; keyword screen of the whole text
extraction.notes: Regional survey report. Only claims about North Macedonia are extracted; regional sentences that do not name it are left out. Chart values are in the converted text only as number strings, so each chart quote runs from the figure title to the end of the legend, with its numbers, and carries the table flag; values were checked against the original PDF. Keyword screen in English (digital, e-government, online, electronic, internet, artificial intelligence, cyber, personal data, foreign workers, work permit, labour mobility, labour market, free movement, recognition, social security, health insurance, pension, EURES, portal) over the whole text found no further in-scope claim. No Chapter 2 items, although the register lists chapter 02: the migration and mobility section (pages 56-58), Figure 15 on youth, and the EU membership benefit 'freedom to study and/or work in the EU' (pages 17, 51) concern North Macedonian nationals' willingness to work abroad and access to EU labour markets, which the run record places outside the Chapter 2 boundary, and the text does not link them to the rights of EU or foreign workers, EURES or social security coordination. Also left out: hours spent online (Figure 49), digital skills as a concern (not linked to an in-scope recommendation), child safety online and frequency of AI use (Figure 53), and awareness of the Regional Cooperation Council's roaming work (page 84), which is about awareness of the Council. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2).
